groups.name: Sara Duterte Impeachment Trial
groups.narrative: The House of Representatives is finalizing its prosecution panel for the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte, despite potential for her absence.
groups.narrative_zh: 众议院正在确定副总统萨拉·杜特尔特的弹劾审判检察官小组，尽管她可能缺席审理。
groups.R_reason: Impeachment trials have binary outcomes: convicted or acquitted.
groups.S_reason: Senate of the Philippines official records.
groups.T_reason: Expected to conclude within the 2026 legislative calendar.
groups.U_reason: Political volatility makes the outcome highly uncertain.
groups.H_reason: High public interest and multi-source coverage.
groups.suggested_question: Will Sara Duterte be convicted in the impeachment trial by end of 2026?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 萨拉·杜特尔特是否会在2026年底前被弹劾审判定罪？

groups.name: Bato dela Rosa Legal Challenges
groups.narrative: Senator Bato dela Rosa faces legal scrutiny including ICC-related challenges and PNP subpoenas regarding ongoing investigations.
groups.narrative_zh: 参议员德拉罗萨正面临法律审查，包括与国际刑事法院相关的挑战及菲律宾国家警察的传唤。
groups.R_reason: Court and agency orders provide clear binary resolutions.
groups.S_reason: Supreme Court of the Philippines and PNP official statements.
groups.U_reason: Outcome of motions and ICC warrants is highly debated.
groups.H_reason: Significant political coverage and social media activity.
groups.suggested_question: Will the Supreme Court issue a permanent injunction against the ICC warrant for Bato dela Rosa in 2026?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 最高法院是否会在2026年针对德拉罗萨的国际刑事法院逮捕令发出永久禁令？

groups.name: Marcos Administration Policy
groups.narrative: President Marcos is balancing diplomatic balancing acts between China and the US while addressing domestic fiscal disclosures.
groups.narrative_zh: 马科斯总统正在中美之间维持外交平衡，并处理国内财政披露问题。
groups.R_reason: Policy success is often measured by qualitative outcomes.
groups.T_reason: Annual legislative and fiscal reporting cycles.
groups.U_reason: International geopolitical tensions create high uncertainty.
groups.H_reason: Coverage primarily in established policy media.

groups.name: Philippine Energy Grid Issues
groups.narrative: The Philippines is experiencing recurring grid alerts and concerns over infrastructure safety and rising fuel costs.
groups.narrative_zh: 菲律宾正经历频繁的电网警报，以及对基础设施安全和燃料成本上涨的担忧。
groups.R_reason: Grid alert status is data-driven and publicly tracked.
groups.S_reason: Department of Energy (DOE) and NGCP daily bulletins.
groups.U_reason: Grid stability is sensitive to weather and supply-demand shifts.
groups.H_reason: High consumer impact and media attention.
groups.suggested_question: Will the Visayas grid be placed under 'Red Alert' for more than 5 days in June 2026?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 2026年6月维萨亚斯电网处于“红色警报”的天数是否超过5天？

groups.name: Philippine Public Health Status
groups.narrative: Monitoring of hantavirus, dengue, and international crew quarantine support protocols.
groups.narrative_zh: 针对汉坦病毒、登革热以及国际船员检疫支持方案的监测。
groups.R_reason: Disease case counts are tracked by government health agencies.
groups.suggested_question: Will the number of reported Dengue cases exceed 5,000 in the Philippines for the month of June 2026?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 2026年6月菲律宾报告的登革热病例数是否会超过5000例？

groups.name: Global Health & Pandemics
groups.narrative: WHO concerns regarding Ebola and antimicrobial resistance report updates.
groups.narrative_zh: 世界卫生组织对埃博拉病毒的担忧以及抗微生物药物耐药性报告更新。
groups.R_reason: Global health crises are complex to binary-test.
groups.U_reason: Disease spread dynamics are standardly monitored.
groups.H_reason: High visibility due to post-pandemic sensitivity.

groups.name: Technological Advancements
groups.narrative: Major tech firms including Google and Samsung are shifting focus toward AI-integrated consumer hardware.
groups.narrative_zh: 谷歌和三星等大型科技公司正将重点转向人工智能集成的消费电子硬件。
groups.R_reason: Product launches are concrete, but timelines shift.

groups.name: Economic & Market Trends
groups.narrative: Ongoing volatility in Southeast Asian currencies, banking risks, and shifting corporate sustainability strategies.
groups.narrative_zh: 东南亚货币的持续波动、银行业风险以及企业可持续发展战略的调整。
groups.R_reason: Financial data and exchange rates are concrete.
groups.S_reason: Central bank and stock exchange data.
groups.suggested_question: Will the PHP/USD exchange rate be above 58.00 at the end of Q3 2026?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 2026年第三季度末菲律宾比索兑美元汇率是否会高于58.00？

groups.name: Sports & Esports
groups.narrative: Extensive coverage of NBA playoffs, European football transitions, and international tennis events.
groups.narrative_zh: 对NBA季后赛、欧洲足球转会以及国际网球赛事的大量报道。
groups.suggested_question: Will the Knicks win the 2026 NBA Championship?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 尼克斯队是否会赢得2026年NBA总冠军？

groups.name: Philippine Local Issues
groups.narrative: A mix of local education funding, crime/security incidents, lottery results, and weather-related disruptions.
groups.narrative_zh: 包括地方教育资金、犯罪/安全事件、彩票结果以及天气引发的混乱等杂项。
groups.R_reason: Some are verifiable (lottery), others (crime reports) are harder to define.
